image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two baby bibs resting on a textured beige carpet. The primary subject is a white fabric bib with a curved neck opening and a decorative embroidered panel featuring small colorful motifs (possibly animals or shapes). A second bib, red with a busy pattern of cartoon dinosaurs and vehicles, is partially visible in the bottom right corner. The lighting is bright, casting soft shadows, highlighting the texture of the white terry cloth or cotton material.
